in_sanskrit.name: Anandkumār
in_sanskrit.meaning: Blissful Lord, Joyful to the Lord
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anandam meaning bliss or happiness and kumār meaning lord or young boy. This name signifies being joyful to the Lord or a joyful young boy. It is a common name in Hindu communities.

in_marathi.name: Anandkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anandkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anand means 'bliss' and Kumar means 'young god'. The name Anandkumar represents a young god who brings happiness and joy.
